title: Reform UK, the Russian spy and rolls of Kremlin cash: the inside story of Nathan Gill
summary: How did a former Mormon bishop end up pleading guilty to taking bribes to make statements in favour of Russia in the European parliament? The first thing most people recall about Nathan Gill is his imposing height. At 193cm (6ft 4in), the one-time Reform UK leader in Wales towered over colleagues and opponents – and he was taller still in his favourite cowboy boots. Continue reading...

title: Lost grave of daughter of Black abolitionist Olaudah Equiano found by A-level student
summary: Fitzwilliam Museum has uncovered student’s work from 1977 that revealed Cambridgeshire location of child’s burial place An A-level pupil found the lost grave of the Black abolitionist Olaudah Equiano’s daughter, revealing a story of love and solidarity in 18th-century rural England. Olaudah Equiano (1745-1797), also known as Gustavus Vassa, escaped enslavement to become a celebrated author and campaigner in Georgian England. His memoir, The Interesting Narrative of the Life of Olaudah Equiano, or Gustavus Vassa, the African, was a bestseller. Continue reading...
